headline: Passage Falters as Weathered Expanse Holds Fury
war_summary: Since the midday edition fresh wires show Callahan's Passage shifting again, with two changes in the last two hours to the cutoff hour moving holdings to eight Warden, one Colonial and one destroyed about the Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post, against day losses listed at 8,849 Colonial and 7,865 Warden. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest fighting on the desk, adding four changes in two hours and forty-five on the day about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch to 14:35, holdings now two Warden, five Colonial and two destroyed, with day losses of 8,973 Colonial and 10,331 Warden. Stlican Shelf has stirred after quiet hours, logging two changes in two hours to the cutoff about Fort Hoarfrost, holdings now three Warden, five Colonial and one destroyed. Palantine Berm, Mooring County and Nevish Line have gone quiet, with no flip in six hours or more, the last reports from 05:33, 03:57 and 21:55 the prior evening respectively.
